data.case_title: Invoice from Sprachinstitut Beispielwort for German course B1
data.explanation: Sprachinstitut Beispielwort, a German language school, sent this invoice for the intensive B1 course and the telc exam fee, totalling €815.00. The fee must be transferred within the deadline shown, quoting the invoice number SW-2027-0129, to the IBAN printed on the invoice. If you don't pay in time, the school may send a reminder or delay your course place, though no specific consequence is stated. Keep the invoice for your records in case the course relates to your taxes.
